== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Stunning Leader (Japanese)|Stunning Leader]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67793 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(24, 10, 468, 620)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>3ebac20e9a6e3c07a81b7890f0ba735c2f06fde08a45c310fcdbf95a5e1732f9</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
